source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 8 summary (PDF 204).

blocks.text: Is chapter ne online research, digital literacy aur intellectual property batayi: online research ki ahmiyat aur qismein; technology istemal, maloomat dhoondne aur parakhne, mawad banane aur mehfooz rehne ki digital literacy maharatein; advanced search ke tareeqe; research sawal aur hypothesis banana; digital wasail ka istemal; research ethics; aur intellectual property ki qismein, patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs aur trade secrets, jo takhleeqi aur jiddat wale kaam ko bachati hain.

items: Samajhdari se talash, maakhaz ki parakh, wazeh sawal, akhlaqi research aur intellectual property ka ehtaram.
